import hashlib, importlib.util, json, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path.cwd()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('prov', p / 'tools/build_provenance.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
current = m.source_inputs(p)
recorded = json.loads((p / 'build-source-aurora-opencode-pro.exe.json').read_text())
exe = p / 'aurora-opencode-pro.exe'
assert hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == recorded['binary_sha256'], 'live executable changed after build'
assert current['source_fingerprint'] == recorded['source_fingerprint'], 'source changed after build'
assert current['source_commit'] == recorded['source_commit'], 'source commit changed after build'
for rel in ['source/auroraopencode/controlhistory.d', 'source/auroraopencode/requestbuilder.d']:
    assert exe.stat().st_mtime > (p / rel).stat().st_mtime, 'binary is older than ' + rel
print('PASS live executable hash matches build provenance for the current source fingerprint and is newer than the fixed sources')
